subject: Trial plan and deployment mode recommendation for Atlas Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <s.chen@atlashealth.com>, Markus Engel <markus.engel@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Trial plan and deployment mode recommendation for Atlas Health
Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-checklist.pdf

Thanks again for your time earlier, Sophie + Markus — good conversation. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we can get a scoped trial moving quickly.

Key discovery notes from today:
- Data sensitivity: Atlas will process PHI for a narrow set of clinical summarization tasks (HIPAA scope confirmed).
- Latency target: p95 <= 150ms for 512-token sequences for the summarization API.
- Throughput: expected 15 concurrent requests during peak with burst to 60 for batch loads.
- Retention & audit: logs must be retained for 12 months; auditability (access logs + KMS key IDs) required.

Deployment recommendation (short version): Private VPC deployment with customer-managed VPC peering (or private endpoint) to meet PHI and audit controls. Dedicated capacity could be an interim option if Atlas prefers a managed environment without network integration, but it won't meet the "no egress" network requirement. Hosted API is not suitable for PHI without additional contractual controls.

Proposed 4-week trial (PoC) — objectives and success criteria:
1) Week 0: Kickoff + infra prep
   - Confirm network approach (VPC peering vs private endpoint)
   - Exchange required IP ranges and CIDR
2) Week 1: Private deployment + ingress testing
   - Deploy Redwood Private into Atlas staging VPC
   - Verify KMS integration and audit logging
3) Week 2: Functional validation
   - Run 3 representative prompt flows against staging dataset (sanitized)
   - Acceptance: output fidelity >= baseline (we'll share eval prompts)
4) Week 3: Load & latency testing
   - Simulate peak concurrency; verify p95 latency <= 150ms and no error spikes
5) Week 4: Sign-off & knowledge transfer
   - Final report, runbook, and handoff to Atlas SRE + procurement checklist

Owners:
- Atlas: Sophie Chen (Project lead), Markus Engel (IT/network), Procurement to confirm SLA/legal timelines
- Redwood: Karthik Iyer (AE, project lead), Vivek Kulkarni (SE), Monica Patel (Customer Success)

Immediate asks from Atlas to proceed:
- Confirm stakeholders (names/emails) for IT/legal/procurement
- Confirm whether you'll provide a sanitized sample dataset or want Redwood to run with synthetic data
- Preferred kickoff window (we can start as early as next Tuesday)

I've attached a short VPC checklist to speed the network steps. If Atlas confirms PHI and is comfortable with Private VPC, we'll provision a staging stack and schedule a 60-minute kickoff with IT and SE.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a calendar invite once we have confirmation.

– Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Trial plan and deployment mode recommendation for Atlas Health

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: this workload touches PHI and we must avoid routing PHI through any multi-tenant public endpoints. Private VPC is our preference.
- Compliance: our security team will need to review KMS/HSM options and whether Redwood can support customer-managed keys (CMK).
- Stakeholders: I will loop in our Procurement lead (elaine.wu@atlashealth.com) and our Security reviewer (reza.karimi@atlashealth.com). Markus will own the network details.

Two questions:
1) If we opt for Private VPC, can Redwood support HSM-backed key wraps or do you require AWS KMS only?
2) We also want to understand the on-prem option briefly — is that a separate engagement or part of Private?

We're mostly aligned on the timeline; next Tuesday kickoff works for us if we can get the checklist and a short network intake form beforehand. Can Vivek or Monica run the kickoff?

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Chen | Director, AI Platforms | Atlas Health

Hi Sophie / Markus — Vivek from Redwood SE team here. Happy to run the kickoff and own the technical plan. Quick responses to your questions and a compact PoC checklist.

HSM / KMS:
- Redwood Private supports AWS KMS customer-managed keys today. For HSM-backed key wrap (external HSM/HSM-as-a-service), we can integrate via partner patterns but will need a short architecture call and scope agreement. Please include Reza on that call.

On-prem option:
- On-prem is a separate engagement (air-gapped package). It is possible within the same commercial relationship but requires additional lead time (typically 6–8 weeks for our packages and validation). For the PoC timeframe you described, Private VPC is the fastest path.

Compact PoC technical checklist (what we will do during the 4-week run):
- Network: exchange CIDRs, open management ports (list in attached checklist), validate peering and route tables
- Auth: configure CMK and test sign/unwrap flows; provide audit log sample for your security review
- Data: use the attached sanitized sample (atlas-poc-data-sample.csv). If Atlas prefers, provide a small sanitized subset (<= 10k rows) to mirror production characteristics
- Latency tests: run 30-minute ramp tests to simulate 15->60 concurrent requests; capture p50/p95/p99 and error rates
- Quality checks: run our 50-eval prompt set against staging; we'll share a diff report comparing outputs to your baseline
- Runbook & handoff: generate runbook, NFRs, and remediation steps for common failures

Deliverables and owners:
- Redwood: staging deployment artifacts, latency report, evaluation report, runbook (Vivek, Monica)
- Atlas: provide sanitized data sample OR approve synthetic mode (Sophie), provide procurement/contract contacts (Elaine), provide security reviewer (Reza)

Proposed kickoff times (PT): Wed 2026-05-12 10:00 or Thu 2026-05-13 14:00. I'll send a calendar invite for the slot you confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Vivek Kulkarni
